lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: South-west extraction is open. It will not stay open.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Hangar lockdown begins the instant the first frame moves.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: Those pilots were my unit yesterday.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Today they stand between us and the truth. Move.

lines.speaker: broadcast
lines.text: Terrorist Vale attacked a detention complex and abducted government personnel in stolen war machines.

lines.speaker: nyx
lines.text: For the record, nobody abducted me.

lines.speaker: reyes
lines.text: Three damaged frames, Kell in a stolen utility truck, and almost no supplies.

lines.speaker: vale
lines.text: Then we survive the next hour first.

lines.speaker: kell
lines.text: The route collapsed. Pull back into the service blocks; I will build another opening.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: Extraction marked south-west. Move before the outer cordon forms.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Hangar lockdown is active. Every patrol in the district just received our position.

midBattle.speaker: nyx
midBattle.text: First time firing on my own uniform. It feels exactly as bad as expected.

midBattle.speaker: kell
midBattle.text: You are halfway across. External pursuit mechs are mobilizing.

midBattle.speaker: reyes
midBattle.text: Vale’s frame is failing. Commander, do not make the escape without yourself.
